objective: Implement music composition and adaptive-music authoring over the MSAS session/edit/mix foundations, including tempo, meter, key, MIDI/arrangement and adaptive segment/layer/transition/intensity intent, without creating a second gameplay-state machine or replacing AAI runtime authority.
boundaries: MSAS-01/MSAS-03/MSAS-04 retain workspace, editing and mixing/validation foundations consumed by this tranche.
AAI retains runtime playback, layering, mixer and semantic audio authority.
PCA-07 retains reusable interactive/adaptive-audio authoring and preview primitives; PCA-09 retains generic provider-neutral generation orchestration.
Adaptive music preview may consume synthetic/permitted state but cannot create, infer or mutate canonical gameplay state.
Local/provider-off composition and adaptive authoring remain blocking-capable; paid/cloud generation is optional.
MSAS-07+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state is independent.
